name: TT Vision Holdings Berhad
summary: TT Vision Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, focuses on the entire lifecycle of machine vision equipment. This encompasses the research and development, manufacturing, and global distribution of its advanced systems, alongside providing associated products and services. The company's diverse product portfolio features cutting-edge solutions across several key sectors. For the semiconductor and LED industries, it delivers sophisticated inspection technologies, such as Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) machines designed for wafers, wirebonds, and substrate packages. In the photovoltaic (PV) domain, TT Vision offers a suite of inspection, testing, and sorting products, including WINS solar wafer inspection and sorting machines, IBC and Quad solar cell sorters, and various solar cell AOI solutions (TF, PL, FRV). Furthermore, its robotics division provides a wide array of automated solutions, from robot palletizers and mobile robot integration to cobot polishing, dispensing, test handling, auto packing, spot welding, and machine tending, as well as robotic pick, place, and assembly systems. The company primarily caters to manufacturers within the semiconductor industry. With operations spanning Malaysia, China, South Korea, the Philippines, Germany, the United States, Singapore, Thailand, Japan, and Hong Kong, TT Vision maintains a significant international footprint. Established in 2001, the company is headquartered in Bayan Lepas, Malaysia.
